question: List the long names of teams that in 2012 had above-average build-up play passing and belonged to the league that hosted the most matches in the 2008/2009 season.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_league AS (
    SELECT M.XCL_008 AS league_id
    FROM Match AS M
    WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
    GROUP BY M.XCL_008
    ORDER BY COUNT(M.XCL_006) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_passing AS (
    SELECT AVG(TA.XCL_181) AS avg_bp
    FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
    WHERE TA.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT T.XCL_173
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.XCL_171 = TA.XCL_177
JOIN Match AS M ON T.XCL_171 = M.XCL_013
CROSS JOIN top_league AS tl
CROSS JOIN avg_passing AS ap
WHERE TA.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
  AND TA.XCL_181 > ap.avg_bp
  AND M.XCL_008 = tl.league_id

JOIN "Match" ON "Team"."XCL_171" = "Match"."XCL_013"

    SELECT M.XCL_008 AS league_id
    FROM Match AS M
    WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
    GROUP BY M.XCL_008
    ORDER BY COUNT(M.XCL_006) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_passing AS (
    SELECT AVG(TA.XCL_181) AS avg_bp
    FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
    WHERE TA.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT T.XCL_173
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.XCL_171 = TA.XCL_177
JOIN Match AS M ON T.XCL_171 = M.XCL_013
CROSS JOIN top_league AS tl
CROSS JOIN avg_passing AS ap
WHERE TA.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
  AND TA.XCL_181 > ap.avg_bp
  AND M.XCL_008 = tl.league_id

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH top_league AS (
    SELECT L.XCL_003 AS league_id
    FROM League L
    JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
    WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2008/2009'
    GROUP BY L.XCL_003
    ORDER BY COUNT(M.XCL_006) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_passing AS (
    SELECT AVG(TA.XCL_181) AS avg_bp
    FROM Team_Attributes TA
    WHERE TA.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
)
SELECT T.XCL_173
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.XCL_171 = TA.XCL_177
JOIN top_league tl ON T.XCL_172 = tl.league_id
CROSS JOIN avg_passing ap
WHERE TA.XCL_178 LIKE '2012%'
  AND TA.XCL_181 > ap.avg_bp
